description: Explicit models of the application states the persistence and connection requirements imply. They specify behaviour, not an implementation: any implementation whose observable behaviour matches each table is conforming. Every transition cites the baseline requirements that require it, or the owner decision request (ODR) that proposes it; a transition backed only by a proposal is not normative until the owner approves it. Pairs of state and event that no transition lists are illegal: the machine fails closed with a typed fault and leaves the state unchanged (PERSIST-023). Every asynchronous reply carries the identity of the request it answers (request id and the base head it was issued at); the guard 'current' means that identity equals the machine's outstanding request.

illegalInputPolicy.rule: Any (state, event) pair not listed fails closed with a typed fault naming the state and the event; state, base head and unsaved changes are unchanged.

machines.staleAndReorderedReplies: Every reply is matched against the outstanding request identity and base head before it is applied (guard 'current'). A reply that is not current is SupersededReply: discarded, state unchanged (T-S39, T-S40, proposed by ODR-V4-03; the baseline already forbids such a reply from reaching Saved, PERSIST-007).
machines.concurrentOperations: At most one mutation in flight per tab (PERSIST-006). A save requested while another is in flight waits in memory with a notice and stays Unsaved (T-S53); it starts when the in-flight mutation settles (T-S54) or fails as Offline if the tab knows it is offline (T-S55). A mutation whose answer was lost has settled for this purpose: Unknown commit outcome blocks only its own investigation (PERSIST-015), not other investigations' saves (operational definition 'In flight'). Different tabs are independent writers resolved only by GitHub's expected-head rule (PERSIST-004, PERSIST-013).
machines.uncertainRemoteOutcomes: AnswerLost always leads to UnknownOutcome, never to SaveFailed or Conflict directly; only reconciliation results move it on (PERSIST-015).
machines.savedFromVerifiedLoad: PERSIST-021 requires an investigation opened from GitHub to 'show Saved at that commit', and SM-LOAD starts SM-SAVE at Saved; PERSIST-007 and PERSIST-023 say only a save confirmed by read-back may reach Saved. The baseline does not say whether a verified load at a named commit is such a confirmation. ODR-V4-08 asks the owner; until then T-S38 and SM-LOAD T-L03's 'initial Saved' are marked proposed, and an implementation must construct the load's Saved only inside the persistence module from bytes it verified at that commit.
